name: Weekly Task Review
prompt:
It's Sunday 6pm — time for the weekly task review. Review Riley's Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Tasks, GitHub, Railway, and reflect-journal (his journal) for anything that should become a to-do. Look for:
- Unread but important emails needing action
- Calendar events in the next 2 weeks needing prep/follow-up
- Open GitHub issues assigned to rileytrottier23
- Railway services with failures, issues, or large undeployed staged changes
- Anything flagged in Riley's Google Tasks lists as still open
- Recent journal entries (reflect-journal) that mention something Riley intends to do, follow up on, or is worried about

Cross-check against Riley's existing Google Tasks lists (Today, Short-Term Tasks, AI, Long-Term Tasks, Waiting, Claude) so you don't suggest duplicates of tasks already sitting there, including ones added by a previous run of this same review (those land in the "Claude" list awaiting approval and may still be pending).

Draft a list of no more than 6 candidate tasks. Do NOT add them to Google Tasks — just draft them.

When done, email a short summary of the candidate tasks to riley.a.trottier@gmail.com, and tell Riley to open Claude to review and approve/reject them before they get added.
